brief_title: A 6-Month Consumer Behavior Study of a Self-Management System (0803-084)(COMPLETED)
official_title: A Consumer Use Study of OTC Lovastatin (CUSTOM): A 6-Month Consumer Behavior Study of the Lovastatin OTC Self-Management System

primary_outcomes.measure: Percentage of patients who make appropriate decision for self-management.

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the ability of patients with intermediate risk of heart disease to appropriately use a Self-Management System.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must be able to read and understand English without assistance.
* For Males: Minimum age 45 years and Maximum age N/A (No limit).
* For Females: Minimum age 55 years and Maximum age N/A (No limit).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or nursing
* Drug allergy
